substantiveCorrections.basis: Project mathematical correction: the same answer lists K4 as a cograph, but it has an ordinary edge-deleted subgraph P4 of diameter3. The book explicitly distinguishes ordinary and induced subgraphs on bound Chinese page25/printed10. Cographs exclude inducedP4, so any shortest path of length>=3 in a connected induced subgraph would contradict that definition. A second model independently confirmed this inference; primary definition corroborated by arXiv2012.03185. This is not an author erratum.
